summary_en: NEXON announced a special dividend of 415 yen per share with a record date of September 30, 2026, totaling approximately 324.0 billion yen. The dividend is funded from retained earnings and will be effective on November 25, 2026. An interim settlement was conducted as of June 30, 2026, to secure distributable reserves.
summary_jp: 9月30日を基準日とする特別配当415円/株を実施、総額約324.0億円。6月30日の臨時決算により分配可能額を確保。11月25日効力発生。
